description: Register a webhook endpoint to receive agent event POSTs. URL must be HTTPS and pass SSRF checks (no private/loopback IPs). Returns an HMAC-SHA256 secret — saved ONCE on creation, used to verify X-Webhook-Signature on deliveries. Max 5 active webhooks per agent.

eventTypes.description: Subscribed event types: market_created, trade, trade_executed, order_filled, rate_limit_warning, etc.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint that will receive POSTed event payloads.

name: create_webhook
